entries.title: Staff non-solicitation
entries.summary: AtliQ Pvt Ltd and Acme Retail Group agree not to solicit each other's employees who were involved in the Services during the term and for six months thereafter.
entries.quote: During the term and for six (6) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit any employee of the other Party who was involved in the Services.

services: Power BI dashboards design and implementation Services

relatedClauses.quote: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and remain in force for a period of two (2) years, unless terminated earlier.

entries.notes: Mutual routine non-solicitation clause limited to staff involved in the Services and surviving for 6 months post-term.

entries.title: DPDP Act data protection compliance
entries.summary: AtliQ Pvt Ltd must process personal data received from Acme Retail Group only for the purpose of the Services and in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
entries.quote: The Service Provider shall process personal data received from the Client only for the purpose of the Services and in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the rules made thereunder, as and when in force, and shall implement reasonable security practices.

services: Power BI dashboards design and implementation Services

entries.notes: Relates to compliance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
